notes: Verified BODY&SOUL September 2026 Yamamoto discoveries. Editorial priority reflects Listening Notes RADAR judgment.

events.factual_description: Daytime BODY&SOUL performance during the club's final September run.

en.why_it_matters: Kimiko Ito with Yamamoto in BODY&SOUL's final month gives an already strong vocal-jazz date added historical context.
en.trip_verdict: Build the afternoon around it if already in Tokyo; not a transpacific trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: Kimiko Ito con Yamamoto en el último mes de BODY&SOUL añade contexto histórico a una fecha de jazz vocal ya de por sí fuerte.
es.trip_verdict: Construir la tarde alrededor de esto si ya estás en Tokio; no justifica por sí sola el viaje transpacífico.

events.factual_description: Chika Toyoda with the classic Yamamoto/Kagawa/Osumi trio core at BODY&SOUL.

provenance.note: BODY&SOUL official schedule; reservations were reported closed when checked.

en.why_it_matters: The classic Yamamoto/Kagawa/Osumi core makes this especially relevant to the current Tokyo thread.
en.trip_verdict: Excellent if a cancellation appears; do not build the trip around uncertain admission.

es.why_it_matters: El núcleo clásico Yamamoto/Kagawa/Osumi la hace especialmente relevante para el hilo actual de Tokio.
es.trip_verdict: Gran noche si aparece una cancelación; no construir el viaje dependiendo de una entrada incierta.

events.factual_description: TOKU with Tsuyoshi Yamamoto Group on September 26, the final date of BODY&SOUL's announced '3 Months Final Groove' period ending September 26 after more than five decades of the club's history.

provenance.note: BODY&SOUL official schedule and final-period announcement.

en.why_it_matters: Yamamoto plus TOKU at the end of BODY&SOUL's final announced run turns the night from a strong booking into a potentially irreproducible piece of Tokyo jazz history.
en.trip_verdict: Yes. Music worth traveling for: Yamamoto is the thread, but the closing context makes the night the destination.

es.why_it_matters: Yamamoto más TOKU al final del último ciclo anunciado de BODY&SOUL convierte una gran fecha en un posible momento irrepetible de la historia del jazz de Tokio.
es.trip_verdict: Sí. Música por la que vale la pena viajar: Yamamoto es el hilo, pero el contexto del cierre convierte la noche en destino.
